Film 'Ramayanam' Music Rights Sold for ₹75 Crore

The music rights for the upcoming film 'Ramayanam', covering both parts, have been sold to T-Series for ₹75 crore. This deal reportedly sets a record, surpassing the previous record held by the film 'Dhurandhar'. The sale occurred before the film's release.
